column1: # Applied when GOZJARO_SOURCE_MIRROR is "ustc" or "auto" (see config/lfs.env).
# With "auto" the fetch stage probes the mirror hosts first and silently uses
# upstream if none answers. The longest matching origin prefix wins; anything
# unmatched is served straight from upstream. The downloader always falls
# back to the upstream URL if the mirror 404s / stalls, so a wrong entry can
# never break a build — it just misses the cache hit.
# NOTE: every entry below was spot-checked with a ranged GET and returned 200/204
# (bytes available) from a home network on 2026-10. USTC WAFs some datacenter /
# egress IPs; if an entry 403s from your runner the upstream fallback covers it.
# GNU (ftpmirror + ftp.gnu both map into USTC's /gnu tree, incl. glibc/gcc subfolders)
# kernel.org CDN mirror — e2fsprogs (tytso) lives here, not on www.kernel.org
# sourceware.org (binutils, elfutils, bzip2). USTC does NOT mirror this tree:
# every /sourceware/... path there returns 404. TUNA does mirror it, but
# flattened — the /pub and /ftp path components are dropped — so each
# subtree needs its own entry. (Verified 206/200 with a ranged GET, 2026-10.)
# Debian source pool (expect / procps / psmisc .orig tarballs)
# GitHub (release assets + repo archives). Preserves the path tail.
# Added coverage (each verified 204 from a home network):
#   samba pub (rsync), OpenBSD CDN (OpenSSH portable), ariadne (pkgconf),
# LFS (ch.6) uses the astron.com "file" release tarball (ships a generated
# configure, unlike the GitHub git snapshot). USTC mirrors it under /astron/.
# Debian pool — psmisc/procps-ng .orig tarballs. USTC mirrors Debian under
# /debian/ with the pool/ layout preserved verbatim. (If this mirror entry
# 404s from the runner, download_url falls back to the upstream
# deb.debian.org URL, which is known-reachable from the build VM.)
